data.gender_notes: Arlyne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arlyne is derived from the Old French name Arlette, which means ‘little Arthur’. The name Arlyne is believed to mean ‘mountain of holiness’ or ‘maiden of the mountain’. This name has a spiritual connection to the biblical character, Elijah, who is known for his strength and devotion to God. The name Arlyne carries the meaning “Mountain of holiness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arlyne usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of holiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: ארלין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ארלין נגזר מהמילים העבריות 'אלוהים' ו'אור', שפירושן אלוהים הוא האור. השם מתאר את הקשר בין האל ובין האור, המייצג את הטוב והצדק.

in_greek.name: Αρλύν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αρλύν προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'Θεός' και 'φως', που σημαίνει Θεός είναι το φως. Το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη σύνδεση μεταξύ του Θεού και του φωτός, που αντιπροσωπεύει το καλό και τη δικαιοσύνη.

in_latin.name: Arlyne
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Arlyne derivatur ex Latinis verbis 'Deus' et 'lux', quod significat Deus est lux. Nomen hoc connexionem inter Deum et lucem repraesentat, quae bonum et justitiam symbolizat.
